item.tib: dam can gshin rje'i gnad bskul
item.coloph: stag la me 'bar gyi gdams pa/ klu grub ye shes snying po'i man ngag zhang zhung hris pa gyer med kyi gdam skor/ phung bon mgo dmar gyi brnag pa/ gshin rje rlung bdud nag po'i srog sgrub 'di/ stong chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis zang zang lha brag du gter du sbas sA+o/ rgya rgya rgya/ u yA//
